mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_warehouse ( name, build_time, code, use_volume, use_volume_unit, use_area, use_area_unit, is_automation, is_statistics, is_using, remark, created_time, created_user, pid_route, site_name, last_updated_time ) VALUES ( #{warehouseDto.name}, #{warehouseDto.buildTime}, #{warehouseDto.code}, #{warehouseDto.useVolume}, #{warehouseDto.useVolumeUnit}, #{warehouseDto.useArea}, #{warehouseDto.useAreaUnit}, #{warehouseDto.isAutomation}, #{warehouseDto.isStatistics}, #{warehouseDto.isUsing}, #{warehouseDto.remark}, #{warehouseDto.createdTime}, #{warehouseDto.username}, #{warehouseDto.pidRoute}, #{warehouseDto.siteName}, sysdate() )
mapper.select: SELECT name FROM tb_warehouse WHERE name = #{name} and id != #{id} limit 1
SELECT code FROM tb_warehouse WHERE code = #{code} and id != #{id} limit 1

SELECT id as id,name as name,build_time as buildTime,code as code,use_volume as useVolume,use_area as useArea,use_area_unit as useAreaUnit,is_automation as isAutomation,is_statistics as isStatistics,is_using as isUsing, remark as remark, created_time as createdTime,created_user as createdUser, last_updated_time as lastUpdatedTime,last_updated_user as lastUpdatedUser,created_user_id as createdUserId,pid_route as pidRoute,site_name as siteName FROM tb_warehouse WHERE id = #{warehouseId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_building ( building_no, use_volume, use_volume_unit, use_area, use_area_unit, building_orientation, remark, created_time, created_user, warehouse_id, pid_route, building_name, site_name, last_updated_time ) VALUES ( #{buildingDto.buildingNo}, #{buildingDto.useVolume}, #{buildingDto.useVolumeUnit}, #{buildingDto.useArea}, #{buildingDto.useAreaUnit}, #{buildingDto.buildingOrientation}, #{buildingDto.remark}, #{buildingDto.createdTime}, #{buildingDto.createdUser}, #{buildingDto.warehouseId}, #{buildingDto.pidRoute}, #{buildingDto.buildingName}, #{buildingDto.siteName}, sysdate() )
mapper.select: SELECT `id` as id, `building_no` as buildingNo, `use_volume` as useVolume, `use_volume_unit` as useVolumeUnit, `use_area` as useArea, `use_area_unit` as useAreaUnit, `building_orientation` as buildingOrientation, `remark` as remark, `created_time` as createdTime, `created_user` as createdUser, `last_updated_time` as lastUpdatedTime, `last_updated_user` as lastUpdatedUser, `warehouse_id` as warehouseId, `pid_route` as pidRoute, `building_name` as buildingName, `site_name` as siteName FROM tb_building WHERE id = #{buildingId}
